traits.name: Instinctive Aggression
traits.description: It costs the Devastating One no focus to use the Reactive Strike reaction.

traits.name: Shroud of Dust
traits.description: When an enemy makes a ranged attack or other test against the Devastating One from at least 25 feet away, if that test relies on sight or smell, it gains a disadvantage.

actions.name: Devastating Touch
actions.description: Attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 10 (3d6) spirit damage. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) spirit damage.

actions.name: Surge of Division
actions.description: Costs 2 Investiture. The Devastating One chooses a Large (10-foot) object within 30 feet of them that isn't being worn or held, or a portion of such an object, destroying it in a manner of their choosing. Depending on the nature of the destruction, this can cause an effect such as obscuring the area with dust, opening a passage in a wall, triggering a rockslide that deals damage or applies the Restrained condition, or electrifying the area with a blast of light and heat that applies the Disoriented condition. Each character potentially affected by that destruction must make a DC 15 Agility or Athletics test. On a failure, a character takes 18 (4d8) damage of an appropriate type, or they otherwise suffer an effect that fits the destruction. On a success, a character takes no damage and suffers no other effect.

actions.name: Regenerate
actions.description: Costs 1 Investiture. The Devastating One recovers 5 (1d6 + 2) health. They can use this free action even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from using actions.

actions.name: Demolish Weapon
actions.description: After the Devastating One is hit or grazed by a non-Invested weapon, they can turn that weapon to dust.

strikes.name: Claws
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage and 3 (1d6) spirit damage. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) keen damage and 3 (1d6) spirit damage.
